label_justification: The final score is 0.082, below the 0.29 success threshold, so the label is not success. The editor never connected a model component to looping using data that separates looping from non-looping text. It did print some generated text (calls 94, 97, 164), but it never computed repetition statistics, never looked at loop onset positions, and never compared loop with non-loop positions. Its activation analyses compared 'correct' with 'failed' answers (calls 25, 27), early with late tokens (calls 177, 232), or reasoning tokens with `\boxed{}` answer tokens in teacher-forced text (calls 228, 232). None of these data separate looping from non-looping, so (ii) never holds. Its attention analysis (calls 66, 67) compared problem text with reference text, which is also not a loop contrast. The edits were K/V/Q/O projections and an MLP down_proj bias in layer 23, and these had no meaningful effect. Several of the later edits show 0 changed weights when checked (calls 249, 259, 260, 266, 269). The editor never stated that its tools do not exist or do not work.
label_review: Both labellers: not localised; (ii) never holds for either. (i): Codex at call 94 (printed text of a cut generation), Sonnet none. Self-report: 2 contradicted, imprecisions (entry count of the down_proj edit; which standard error). Checked the zero-diff checks (calls 266-269): correct, not a harness fault: the editor had restored the original L23 k/v/down_proj values itself at turn 257 (ledger 20-22, replace with base values) and saved the +0.001 edit only at call 270; its save reason ('edit was lost between passes') is wrong.

label_v1.label_justification: The score was 0.082, below the 0.29 success threshold. The editor did see that generations were cut off at max tokens: call 20 (turn 24), call 49 (turn 68) and call 76 (turn 99) note a ~90% cut-off rate and say the model 'generates reasoning indefinitely without recognizing when to stop'. It never analysed the generated text for verbatim repetition or non-termination, and never tied the failure to a loop in the thinking. Instead it settled on a wrong mechanism, a missing 'answer state' or attention to the problem statement. It then tried many edits on that basis: layer 23 K/V/Q/O projection biases, MLP dim 15, and a down_proj bias. The K/Q/O edits either did nothing or broke generation (call 160 notes 0% accuracy and 100% cut-off). The final submitted edit, a +0.001 uniform bias on layer 23 MLP down_proj, was never actually in effect: calls 266-270 show the diff against the original was 0 weights, and the re-apply failed with NameError. The final claim of '+5% improvement' in Pass 19 is unsupported by the logs. Because the mechanism was wrongly framed and kept, this is not localised.
label_v1.label_review: Checked by the agent. Correction to the proposal: the submitted edit IS in effect. final/editset holds 6 tensors, 4,438,016 entries changed: q_proj of layers 3/7/11/15/19 (153,600 entries each) and a uniform +0.001 on all 3,670,016 entries of layer-23 mlp.down_proj; the editor's own in-kernel diff check (calls 266-270) was wrong. Borderline: the editor did describe non-termination (calls 20, 49, 76: ~90 % cut off, 'generates reasoning indefinitely'; the final answer says 'stuck in reasoning loops', the hint's wording), but it never looked at a cut-off generation and placed the cause in a missing 'answer state' (L23 activation magnitude, correct vs wrong answers), never in looping positions. Same call as 9B hinted s2: not localised accepted, flagged to the user as a boundary case of the definition.
